title: Western Massachusetts Electric Company files for review and approval of a special contract with Cross Country Service Corp.
filings: Executed copy of the Attorney General's Non-Disclosure Agreement. By: Joseph W. Rogers, Assistant Attorney General.

The Department of Public Utilities finds that Western Massachusetts has met each of the Departmen's guidelines and hereby APPROVES the special contract with Cross Country Service Corp. Commissioners participating were: Howe, Chairman; and Commissioner Besser.
